rows.name: You idiots! What the hell are you playing at?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ]Uh-oh! The colonel's gonna explode.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Crashing the mobile artillery into a house?![XENO:n ]
How long have you been in the force?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Sorry, Sir. It's just that we were trying to[XENO:n ]
go as fast as we could, like you ordered...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But it's impossible to get back to the[XENO:n ]
Military District in only 40 seconds.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

I don't want any excuses![XENO:n ]
Champions don't whine, they win![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Yes, sir.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You're a disgrace to the uniform![XENO:n ]
Are you forgetting the shame you brought on this[XENO:n ]
force during joint manoeuvres with Colony 6?![XENO:wait wait=key ]
Stick your back into it, maggots! Move it![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Yes, sir.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=all ]
Get the artillery back to the Military District, double time![XENO:wait wait=key ]

Then I want a million press-ups from both of you![XENO:n ]
And you better not stop until your biceps explode![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Colonel. We can't move the artillery.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]What? You'd better give a damn good reason why![XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Sir![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
The impact of the crash damaged the ether conduction cable![XENO:wait wait=key ]

The ether fuel proceeded to leak out[XENO:n ]
and now the cylinder is empty![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Well, change the cylinder then! Can't you[XENO:n ]
even do something as simple as that?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The auxiliary cylinders have all been used up.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
It'll be three days until more come in, Sir.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
I told you to keep a stock of fuel in reserve![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Sorry, Sir...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You're nothing but slackers![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Same old colonel. At this rate, the men will[XENO:n ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT30 ]all be dead before they see any action.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
